# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/SECURITY.md` and `docs/DA.md` for every suggestion.

- Vite + Vanilla TypeScript + CSS (MPA), static site on Netlify — no backend
- English file names (`kebab-case`); French UI text in HTML only
- Colors only in `src/styles/variables.css` (DA v3 tokens)
- No secrets, passwords or reflective PDFs in the repo or bundle
- File documentation header on line 1 of each source file
